motivation: distinguish general community activation from multispecies synchrony conditional on any calling activity

shared_data_filter.run_temperature: mean converted °C across >=8 valid sampled stops

activation_endpoint.successes: number of sampled stops with >=1 positively calling species
activation_endpoint.estimand: weather association with P(any calling species)

conditional_overlap_endpoint.successes: number of sampled stops with >=2 positively calling species
conditional_overlap_endpoint.trials: number of sampled stops with >=1 positively calling species
conditional_overlap_endpoint.estimand: weather association with P(>=2 calling species | >=1 calling species)

formula: response ~ rain_z + temp_z + bs(doy, df=5, degree=3) + C(State) + C(RunNumber) + C(RouteType) + year_z

interpretation_rule.conditional_weather_supported: weather is associated with multispecies overlap beyond merely increasing the probability that a stop is acoustically active
interpretation_rule.activation_only: if activation is supported but conditional overlap is not, describe the primary signal as community activation rather than synchrony
interpretation_rule.no_rescue: this decomposition cannot change the original primary or secondary decisions
